visualCharacteristics.purpose: Lufthansa Group for Business sign-in for companies and staff, posted to lh-backends' j_security_check on the site's own host
traits: user name and password fields, the password with a show/hide button
Forgotten Password link to www's forgotten-password page
primary Login button; an alert above the fields for a failed sign-in

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value; every row optional. Type | staff (DESMON, home lhghome); Forgotten password | link; texts: User name label, Password label, Show password, Hide password, Forgotten password, Submit label, Invalid login, No rights, Backend error (English and German built in).

reuseGuidance: One block per sign-in page; change texts with rows. The answer handling is outcome() in b2b-login.js; the session helpers are scripts/b2b-session.js.
